data.narrative:
Beyond Aero is a Series A transportation company founded by Eloa Guillotin, Hugo Tarl\u00e9, and Valentin Chomel. The company has raised $44M to date. The transportation sector contains 8 private frontier-tech peers including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, and FleetZero, with no public comparables available for direct benchmarking.

Stage-progression methodology applies here, using the $44M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Series A to later stages. This yields an implied valuation of $88M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable; although 3 same-sector peers exist in transportation, none satisfy the narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier clustering required for meaningful median derivation. A broad sector median would risk introducing uncontrolled heterogeneity.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $75M (low) to $101M (high), with a median point of $88M. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single applicable method; peer-based triangulation would require either identification of closer stage-matched transportation comparables or acceptance of broader sector benchmarks, neither of which the current data supports. Stage-progression methodology introduces inherent uncertainty around whether a 2.0x multiplier reflects market conditions for this subsector.
